잠언-18-1.title: 잠언 18장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-1.exegesis: 27-28. Prudence of speech is commended as is an excellent or calm spirit, not excited to vain conversation.
잠언-18-1.theologicalNote: 27-28. Prudence of speech is commended as is an excellent or calm spirit, not excited to vain conversation.

잠언-18-2.title: 잠언 18장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 18 Pr 18:1-24 . 1. Through desire ... seeketh-- that is, seeks selfish gratification. intermeddleth ... wisdom-- or, "rushes on" ( Pr 17:14 ) against all wisdom, or what is valuable ( Pr 2:7 ).
잠언-18-2.theologicalNote: CHAPTER 18 Pr 18:1-24 . 1. Through desire ... seeketh-- that is, seeks selfish gratification. intermeddleth ... wisdom-- or, "rushes on" ( Pr 17:14 ) against all wisdom, or what is valuable ( Pr 2:7 ).

잠언-18-3.title: 잠언 18장 3절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-3.exegesis: 2. that his heart ... itself-- that is, takes pleasure in revealing his folly ( Pr 12:23 ; 15:2 ).
잠언-18-3.theologicalNote: 2. that his heart ... itself-- that is, takes pleasure in revealing his folly ( Pr 12:23 ; 15:2 ).

잠언-18-4.title: 잠언 18장 4절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-4.exegesis: 3. So surely are sin and punishment connected ( Pr 16:4 ). wicked, for "wickedness," answers to ignominy, or the state of such; and contempt, the feeling of others to them; and to reproach, a manifestation of contempt.
잠언-18-4.theologicalNote: 3. So surely are sin and punishment connected ( Pr 16:4 ). wicked, for "wickedness," answers to ignominy, or the state of such; and contempt, the feeling of others to them; and to reproach, a manifestation of contempt.

잠언-18-5.title: 잠언 18장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-5.exegesis: 4. Wise speech is like an exhaustless stream of benefit.
잠언-18-5.theologicalNote: 4. Wise speech is like an exhaustless stream of benefit.

잠언-18-6.title: 잠언 18장 6절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-6.exegesis: 5. accept the person-- (Compare Psa 82:2 ). "It is not good" is to be supplied before "to overthrow."
잠언-18-6.theologicalNote: 5. accept the person-- (Compare Psa 82:2 ). "It is not good" is to be supplied before "to overthrow."

잠언-18-7.title: 잠언 18장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-7.exegesis: 6-7. The quarrelsome bring trouble on themselves. Their rash language ensnares them ( Pr 6:2 ).
잠언-18-7.theologicalNote: 6-7. The quarrelsome bring trouble on themselves. Their rash language ensnares them ( Pr 6:2 ).

잠언-18-8.title: 잠언 18장 8절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-8.exegesis: 6-7. The quarrelsome bring trouble on themselves. Their rash language ensnares them ( Pr 6:2 ).
잠언-18-8.theologicalNote: 6-7. The quarrelsome bring trouble on themselves. Their rash language ensnares them ( Pr 6:2 ).

잠언-18-9.title: 잠언 18장 9절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-9.exegesis: 8. (Compare Pr 16:28 ). as wounds-- not sustained by the Hebrew; better, as "sweet morsels," which men gladly swallow. innermost ... belly-- the mind, or heart (compare Pr 20:27-30 ; Psa 22:14 ).
잠언-18-9.theologicalNote: 8. (Compare Pr 16:28 ). as wounds-- not sustained by the Hebrew; better, as "sweet morsels," which men gladly swallow. innermost ... belly-- the mind, or heart (compare Pr 20:27-30 ; Psa 22:14 ).

잠언-18-10.title: 잠언 18장 10절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-10.exegesis: 9. One by failing to get, the other by wasting wealth, grows poor. waster-- literally, "master of washing," a prodigal.
잠언-18-10.theologicalNote: 9. One by failing to get, the other by wasting wealth, grows poor. waster-- literally, "master of washing," a prodigal.

잠언-18-11.title: 잠언 18장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-11.exegesis: 10. name of the Lord-- manifested perfections ( Psa 8:1 ; 20:2 ), as faithfulness, power, mercy, &c., on which men rely. is safe-- literally, "set on high, out of danger" ( Psa 18:2 ; 91:4 ).
잠언-18-11.theologicalNote: 10. name of the Lord-- manifested perfections ( Psa 8:1 ; 20:2 ), as faithfulness, power, mercy, &c., on which men rely. is safe-- literally, "set on high, out of danger" ( Psa 18:2 ; 91:4 ).

잠언-18-12.title: 잠언 18장 12절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-12.exegesis: 11. contrasts with Pr 18:10 (compare Pr 10:15 ). Such is a vain trust (compare Psa 73:6 ).
잠언-18-12.theologicalNote: 11. contrasts with Pr 18:10 (compare Pr 10:15 ). Such is a vain trust (compare Psa 73:6 ).

잠언-18-14.title: 잠언 18장 14절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-14.exegesis: 13. Hasty speech evinces self-conceit, and ensures shame ( Pr 26:12 ).
잠언-18-14.theologicalNote: 13. Hasty speech evinces self-conceit, and ensures shame ( Pr 26:12 ).

잠언-18-15.title: 잠언 18장 15절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-15.exegesis: 14. infirmity-- bodily sickness, or outward evil. The spirit, which sustains, being wounded, no support is left, except, as implied, in God.
잠언-18-15.theologicalNote: 14. infirmity-- bodily sickness, or outward evil. The spirit, which sustains, being wounded, no support is left, except, as implied, in God.

잠언-18-17.title: 잠언 18장 17절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-17.exegesis: 16. (Compare Pr 17:8 , 23 ). Disapproval of the fact stated is implied.
잠언-18-17.theologicalNote: 16. (Compare Pr 17:8 , 23 ). Disapproval of the fact stated is implied.

잠언-18-18.title: 잠언 18장 18절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-18.exegesis: 17. One-sided statements are not reliable. searcheth-- thoroughly ( Pr 17:9 , 19 ).
잠언-18-18.theologicalNote: 17. One-sided statements are not reliable. searcheth-- thoroughly ( Pr 17:9 , 19 ).

잠언-18-19.title: 잠언 18장 19절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-19.exegesis: 18. The lot-- whose disposal is of God ( Pr 16:13 ), may, properly used, be a right mode of settling disputes.
잠언-18-19.theologicalNote: 18. The lot-- whose disposal is of God ( Pr 16:13 ), may, properly used, be a right mode of settling disputes.

잠언-18-20.title: 잠언 18장 20절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-20.exegesis: 19. No feuds so difficult of adjustment as those of relatives; hence great care should be used to avoid them.
잠언-18-20.theologicalNote: 19. No feuds so difficult of adjustment as those of relatives; hence great care should be used to avoid them.

잠언-18-21.title: 잠언 18장 21절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-21.exegesis: 20. (Compare Pr 12:14 ; 13:2 ). Men's words are the fruit, or, increase of his lips, and when good, benefit them. satisfied with-- (Compare Pr 1:31 ; 14:14 ).
잠언-18-21.theologicalNote: 20. (Compare Pr 12:14 ; 13:2 ). Men's words are the fruit, or, increase of his lips, and when good, benefit them. satisfied with-- (Compare Pr 1:31 ; 14:14 ).

잠언-18-22.title: 잠언 18장 22절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-22.exegesis: 21. Death and life-- or, the greatest evil and good. that love it-- that is, the tongue, or its use for good or evil. eat ... fruit-- (Compare Pr 18:19 ; Jas 1:19 ).
잠언-18-22.theologicalNote: 21. Death and life-- or, the greatest evil and good. that love it-- that is, the tongue, or its use for good or evil. eat ... fruit-- (Compare Pr 18:19 ; Jas 1:19 ).

잠언-18-23.title: 잠언 18장 23절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-23.exegesis: 22. The old versions supply "good" before the "wife," as the last clause and Pr 19:14 imply (compare Pr 31:10 ).
잠언-18-23.theologicalNote: 22. The old versions supply "good" before the "wife," as the last clause and Pr 19:14 imply (compare Pr 31:10 ).

잠언-18-24.title: 잠언 18장 24절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-18-24.exegesis: 23. the rich ... roughly-- He is tolerated because rich, implying that the estimate of men by wealth is wrong.
잠언-18-24.theologicalNote: 23. the rich ... roughly-- He is tolerated because rich, implying that the estimate of men by wealth is wrong.
